result.rationale: Ambient was a low-light PV component manufacturer, not an infrastructure owner/operator. I Squared's InfraTech fund is legally classified as venture capital and is described by I Squared as a venture strategy for growth-stage technology companies. No qualifying alternative infrastructure owner was found; exclude the whole company, not merely I Squared's ownership period. Ambient entered an ABC liquidation in 2025.
